description: Accounts Bluesky's AppView withholds that a community this AppView lists still hosts and has not banned, served from what this AppView stores.

restored.description: The marker carried by the view of every such account and its posts (profileViewBasic, profileView, profileViewDetailed, postView including feedViewPost.reply.parent and .root and threadViewPost.post, and embed.record#viewRecord), in every response of this AppView. Absent means the subject is not one. Never on a gap node, notFoundPost, blockedPost or viewNotFound.

community.description: The name of the community that hosts the account, as the operator listed it.

tier.description: 1: the community runs an AppView; 2: it runs a labeler.

labeler.description: The community's labeler, when it has one. Its labels on these views carry it as their src.

viewerChecked.description: On a visitor-form answer: the restored subjects whose viewer state was looked up and answered. A listed post with no viewer.like or viewer.repost has none; a listed actor with no viewer.following has none; a post whose thread root is listed carries viewer.replyDisabled. A subject not listed is unknown. All lists are empty when the operator has visitor viewer state off.

posts.description: Restored posts whose like and repost were both answered.

actors.description: Restored accounts whose following was answered.

roots.description: Thread roots whose replyDisabled is known.

withheld.description: An item a fill named and held back for a reason that is not final.

id.description: The DID or at-URI as named.

reason.description: unanswered: the block check between a visitor and the account got no answer. capped: a discovery limit was reached, so no check was started. proxied: a visitor's call came through a proxy, so no check was started. blocked: the post's author and the caller block each other, either way. unavailable: the profile or post could not be fetched this time (a failed or empty fetch, locally or upstream); ask again later.
